    Procedure code (CPT): 27446

After review, this request is DENIED. Reason for determination: the imaging findings submitted do not support the medical necessity of the requested procedure.

This determination was made under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria. You have the right to appeal this decision. Your appeal must be received within 180 days of the date of this notice (by 2027-02-21).

Reference number: POC-1ACF427871-17933
